description: Type the missing custom-region route. Daytona Cloud does not serve POST /regions (custom regions are a self-hosted / enterprise deployment feature even though the open-source spec declares it): the NestJS router answers HTTP 404 "Cannot POST /api/regions" (observed live 2026-11-03, API v0.229.2).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: This Daytona deployment does not offer custom regions (HTTP 404 on POST /regions).
